methodology.implementation_order: rotates json/dcbor/cbor2_default/cbor2_canonical/cborx_default/cborx_canonical start order across fresh processes
methodology.summary: median of per-process batch means; dispersion is median absolute deviation (MAD)
methodology.decode_input: precomputed encoded bytes for that implementation and fixture
methodology.round_trip: one encode followed by one decode within each timed call

cbor_comparators.dcbor: dcbor source extension version 0.1.0, required release artifact
cbor_comparators.cbor2_default: generic CBOR library cbor2==6.1.5, dumps() default canonical=False
cbor_comparators.cbor2_canonical: generic CBOR library cbor2==6.1.5, dumps(canonical=True), length-first key order (legacy RFC 8949 section 4.2.3)
cbor_comparators.cborx_default: generic CBOR library cborx==0.2.5, dumps() default canonical=False; backend recorded
cbor_comparators.cborx_canonical: generic CBOR library cborx==0.2.5, dumps(canonical=True), bytewise encoded-key order per project documentation

methodology.map_key_order: dcbor and cborx canonical=True use bytewise ordering; cbor2 canonical=True uses length-first ordering (legacy RFC 8949 section 4.2.3)
methodology.cbor_scope: cbor2 and cborx are generic CBOR comparators, not dCBOR implementations; defaults and canonical modes are reported separately
methodology.excluded: strict validation is excluded because comparator validation semantics differ
